emily: Heads-up: I'm putting together a short Troubleshooting entry for 429s and context-limit fallbacks. Aim: tiny cookable snippets (curl / py / node), a migration blurb for SDK v0.11, and 3 quick remediation steps. Who can drop what? :nerd_face:
sam: I can write the Python bits. Will show Retry-After parsing + a small exponential backoff with jitter. Keep it > practical, < pedantic.
matt: I'll take curl streaming example and a single-sentence note about preferring header-driven waits when present. Also add a one-liner for cross-region failover on persistent 5xx/429.
irene: Found a stale link in /guides/limits -> old rfc. I'll swap to https://redwood.ai/docs/limits#too-many-requests in the PR.
emily: For the migration note, call out the param rename max_context -> context_limit and mention auto_trim default change. One tiny example each side.
sam: Python draft:
```python
# simple 429 handler: prefer Retry-After, else exponential backoff + jitter
import time, random
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.generate(...)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        ra = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 0))
        if ra:
            time.sleep(ra)
        else:
            time.sleep((2 ** attempt) * 0.4 + random.random() * 0.25)
        continue
    break
```
Note: use the SDK retry_policy in production for metrics and bounded retries.
matt: curl/streaming example:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge","prompt":"...","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# if you receive 429, check Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset headers; consider fallback to a smaller model or use cached prefix
```
emily: Fallback steps (super short):
1) retry w/ backoff (short window),
2) route to cheaper variant or a cached response,
3) file support ticket with request ids + sample payload if sustained.
irene: I'll open the PR titled "docs: compact 429 troubleshooting + migration snippets" and include the link fix and changelog note. I'll rebase if docs-bot warns about TOC changes.
sam: Node snippet for Retry-After parsing:
```js
const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
if (ra) await sleep(ra * 1000);
else await sleep(backoffMs);
```
emily: SDK migration snippet (v0.10 -> v0.11) to include in runbook:
```python
# v0.10
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_context=4096)
# v0.11
resp = client.generate(prompt, context_limit=4096, auto_trim=True)
```
matt: Also add one line on context overflows: "If prompt length exceeds context_limit, trim oldest turns or switch to retrieval (embeddings + retrieval) to preserve useful context." Keep it in the runbook lead.
